## What changed

Describe the governance, template, or validation change.

## Why

Explain the problem, evidence, and intended owner/project effect.

## Authority and propagation

- Owner decision or authorization:
- Does this reduce an existing safeguard? If yes, link the explicit approval and rationale.
- Which projects, if any, should deliberately adopt this release?
- Confirm that no project will silently follow `latest`.

## Validation

- [ ] `./checks/validate-repository.sh`
- [ ] Complete diff reviewed
- [ ] `VERSION`, `PLAYBOOK.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `RELEASES.md` agree when releasing
- [ ] New guides are linked from `guides/README.md`; local Markdown links validate
- [ ] Time-sensitive tool, standard, legal, platform, and compliance references include a verification date or recheck trigger
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, private messages, financial data, contacts, locations, or production data are included
